gaps.title: Fix 401 Unauthorized rejection of valid API requests
gaps.jtbd: When making an authenticated request to the dossier API, I want it to return the documented 200/201 status, so that the product's document listing and report generation features are usable.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given valid credentials, When requesting dossier search or reports, Then the endpoints return the correct documented HTTP status (e.g., 200 or 201). Given invalid credentials, When requesting, Then it returns 401.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: The brief explicitly requires fixing the API so that authenticated requests are not incorrectly rejected with HTTP 401 and the CI pipeline passes. In SecurityConfig, while /api/v1/dossier/** is supposedly mapped, the tests configured to test EmployeeDossierController and related slices consistently fail with unauthorized or illegal state due to context loading issues rooted in how security handles these requests under test/production conditions.
